new_vehicle_warranty.name: Porsche New Vehicle Limited Warranty
coverage: Bumper-to-bumper coverage for defects in materials and workmanship
exclusions: Normal wear and tear (brake pads, wiper blades, tires, bulbs)
Damage from accidents, misuse, or neglect

corrosion_warranty.name: Corrosion Perforation Warranty
corrosion_warranty.coverage: Protection against rust-through perforation of body panels from the inside out

emissions_warranty.name: Federal Emissions Warranty
emissions_warranty.coverage: Major emissions control components including catalytic converters and ECU

hybrid_ev_battery_warranty.name: High-Voltage Battery Warranty
hybrid_ev_battery_warranty.coverage: High-voltage battery pack defects and capacity degradation below 70%
hybrid_ev_battery_warranty.note: Separate from the main vehicle warranty — provides extended protection for EV/hybrid battery systems

porsche_approved_cpo.name: Porsche Approved Certified Pre-Owned
requirements: Vehicle must be under 15 years old
Must be purchased from an authorized Porsche dealer
porsche_approved_cpo.coverage: Comprehensive coverage similar to new vehicle warranty

extended_warranty.name: Porsche Extended Warranty
extended_warranty.description: Optional extended coverage available for purchase before your factory warranty expires

plans.name: Porsche Platinum
plans.coverage: Most comprehensive — covers nearly all mechanical and electrical components
plans.recommended_for: Owners planning to keep their vehicle long-term

plans.name: Porsche Gold
plans.coverage: Covers major mechanical components including powertrain, electrical, and climate systems

roadside_assistance.name: Porsche Roadside Assistance
roadside_assistance.included_with: New vehicle warranty and CPO warranty
services: Trip interruption benefits (hotel, meals, rental car)
roadside_assistance.available: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
